6800.grammar: prp of na paṭikujjhati, neg, pass, intrans
6800.meaning1: not getting angry back; not being upset in return

examples.text: tass'eva tena pāpiyo, yo kuddhaṃ paṭikujjhati, kuddhaṃ appaṭikujjhanto, saṅgāmaṃ jeti dujjayaṃ.

6801.meaning1: not scorned; not disapproved of; not disdained; not rejected (by)

examples.text: tayo'me, bhikkhave, niruttipathā adhivacanapathā paññattipathā asaṅkiṇṇā asaṅkiṇṇapubbā, na saṅkīyanti, na saṅkīyissanti, appaṭikuṭṭhā samaṇehi brāhmaṇehi viññūhi. katame tayo?
imāni cattāri ariyasaccānī'ti, bhikkhave, mayā dhammo desito aniggahito asaṃkiliṭṭho anupavajjo appaṭikuṭṭho samaṇehi brāhmaṇehi viññūhī'ti. iti yaṃ taṃ vuttaṃ idam'etaṃ paṭicca vuttan'ti.

6802.grammar: fem, abstr, from na paṭikulya, neg (+loc)
6802.construction:
na > a + pati + √kūl + ya + tā
appaṭikulya + tā

examples.text: evaṃdiṭṭhino, bhikkhave, etaṃ pāṭikaṅkhaṃ, yā c'āyaṃ bhave appaṭikulyatā, sā c'assa na bhavissati. yā c'āyaṃ bhavanirodhe pāṭikulyatā, sā c'assa na bhavissatī'ti.

sace, bhikkhave, bhikkhuno asubhasaññāparicitena cetasā bahulaṃ viharato methunadhammasamāpattiyā cittaṃ anusandahati appaṭikulyatā saṇṭhāti, veditabbam'etaṃ, bhikkhave, bhikkhunā, abhāvitā me asubhasaññā

6803.commentary: (SNa) appaṭikūlan'ti duvidhaṃ appaṭikūlaṃ, satta-appaṭikūlañ'ca, saṅkhāra-appaṭikūlañ'ca. tasmiṃ appaṭikūle iṭṭhe vatthusmin'ti attho.

examples.text: sace ākaṅkhati appaṭikūle paṭikūlasaññī vihareyyan'ti paṭikūlasaññī tattha viharati
sace ākaṅkhati, paṭikūlañ'ca appaṭikūlañ'ca tadubhayaṃ abhinivajjetvā upekkhako vihareyyaṃ sato sampajāno'ti

6804.meaning1: perceiving as agreeable; regarding (something) as not disagreeable
6804.commentary: (MNa) paṭikūle appaṭikūlasaññī'ti-ādīsu paṭikūle mettāpharaṇena vā dhātuso upasaṃhārena vā appaṭikūlasaññī viharati.

examples.text: so sace ākaṅkhati paṭikūle appaṭikūlasaññī vihareyyan'ti, appaṭikūlasaññī tattha viharati.

6805.grammar: abs of na paṭikkosati, neg, trans (+acc)
6805.meaning1: having not disapproved; having not rejected; having not refused
6805.construction:
na > a + pati + kosa + itvā
na + paṭikositvā

examples.text: so kho ahaṃ, bhante, pūraṇassa kassapassa bhāsitaṃ n'eva abhinandiṃ nappaṭikkosiṃ. anabhinanditvā appaṭikositvā anattamano, anattamanavācaṃ anicchāretvā, tam'eva vācaṃ anuggaṇhanto anikkujjanto uṭṭhāy'āsanā pakkamiṃ.
sādhu, bhikkhave, bhikkhu kālena kālaṃ appaṭikkūle paṭikkūlasaññī vihareyya.

6807.grammar: abs of na paṭikkosati, neg, trans (+acc)
6807.meaning1: having not disapproved; having not rejected
6807.construction:
na > a + pati + kosa + itvā
na + paṭikkositvā

examples.text: tassa, bhikkhave, bhikkhuno bhāsitaṃ n'eva abhinanditabbaṃ nappaṭikkositabbaṃ. anabhinanditvā appaṭikkositvā tāni padabyañjanāni sādhukaṃ uggahetvā sutte otāretabbāni, vinaye sandassetabbāni.

atha kho te bhikkhū tesaṃ aññatitthiyānaṃ paribbājakānaṃ bhāsitaṃ n'eva abhinandiṃsu nappaṭikkosiṃsu, anabhinanditvā appaṭikkositvā uṭṭhāy'āsanā pakkamiṃsu, bhagavato santike etassa bhāsitassa atthaṃ ājānissāmā'ti.

6808.meaning2: (comm) not worthy of consideration or respect

6809.meaning1: (vinaya) not formally accepted; not received by a monastic
6809.construction:
na > a + pati + √gah + ita + ka
appaṭiggahita + ka

examples.text: adinnaṃ nāma appaṭiggahitakaṃ vuccati.

6810.meaning1: (vinaya) not formally accepted; not received by a monastic

examples.text: anatirittaṃ nāma akappiyakataṃ hoti, appaṭiggahitakataṃ hoti, anuccāritakataṃ hoti, ahatthapāse kataṃ hoti, abhuttāvinā kataṃ hoti, bhuttāvinā pavāritena āsanā vuṭṭhitena kataṃ hoti

6811.meaning1: perceiving as not formally accepted; regarding (something) as not received

examples.text: appaṭiggahitake appaṭiggahitakasaññī adinnaṃ mukhadvāraṃ āhāraṃ āhāreti, aññatra udakadantaponā, āpatti pācittiyassa.

6812.commentary: (SNPa) cātuddiso'ti catūsu disāsu yathāsukhavihārī, ekaṃ disaṃ pharitvā viharatī'ti-ādinā (dī. ni. 3.308, a. ni. 4.125, cūḷani. khaggavisāṇasuttaniddesa 128) vā nayena brahmavihāra-bhāvanā-pharitā catasso disā assa santī'ti'pi cātuddiso. tāsu disāsu katthaci satte vā saṅkhāre vā bhayena na paṭihaññatī'ti appaṭigho.

examples.text: cātuddiso appaṭigho ca hoti, santussamāno itar'ītarena, parissayānaṃ sahitā achambhī, eko care khaggavisāṇakappo.

6813.meaning1: (abhi) intangible; not impinging; not producing a sensory reaction
6813.meaning2: not resisting, not reacting, not producing reaction

examples.text: sanidassanasappaṭighā dhammā. anidassanasappaṭighā dhammā. anidassana-appaṭighā dhammā.

6815.construction:
na > a + pati + √ghaṭ + a + vant
apaṭigha + vant

examples.text: tassā'y'eva kho pana dukkhāya vedanāya phuṭṭho samāno paṭighavā na hoti. tam'enaṃ dukkhāya vedanāya appaṭighavantaṃ, yo dukkhāya vedanāya paṭigh'ānusayo, so n'ānuseti.

6816.grammar: prp of na pati √ghaṃs, neg, intrans
6816.meaning1: not rubbing to pieces; not scratching; not knocking against

examples.text: sace yāgu hoti, bhājanaṃ dhovitvā yāgu upanāmetabbā. yāguṃ pītassa udakaṃ datvā bhājanaṃ paṭiggahetvā nīcaṃ katvā sādhukaṃ appaṭighaṃsantena dhovitvā paṭisāmetabbaṃ.

6817.construction:
na > a + pati + √i + tya
na + paṭicca

examples.text: so evaṃ pajānāti, uppannā kho my'āyaṃ sukhā vedanā. sā ca kho paṭicca, no appaṭicca. kiṃ paṭicca? imam'eva kāyaṃ paṭicca.
na h'eva kho pana paṭicchannaṃ āsanaṃ hotī'ti appaṭicchannaṃ hoti kuṭṭena vā kavāṭena vā kilañjena vā sāṇipākārena vā rukkhena vā thambhena vā kotthaḷiyā vā yena kenaci appaṭicchannaṃ hoti.

6819.meaning1: with unconcealed deeds; who is not furtive in action; acting openly
6819.commentary: (ANa) paṭicchannakamm'antassā'ti pāpakammassa. pāpaṃ hi paṭicchādetvā karonti. no ce'pi paṭicchādetvā karonti, pāpakammaṃ paṭicchannam'evā'ti vuccati.

examples.text: appaṭicchannakamm'antassa, bhikkhave, dvinnaṃ gatīnaṃ aññatarā gati pāṭikaṅkhā, devā vā manussā vā'ti.

6820.grammar: fem, abstr, from na paṭijānāti, neg (+gen)
6820.meaning1: without agreement; without acknowledgement; without consent (of)

examples.text: evam'evaṃ kho, ānanda, pūraṇena kassapena appaṭiññāya etesaṃ samaṇabrāhmaṇānaṃ imā chaḷabhijātiyo paññattā, yathā taṃ bālena abyattena akhettaññunā akusalena.

6821.commentary: (ANa) appaṭinissaggamantino'ti yesaṃ hi evaṃ hoti, sace amhehi gahitaṃ adhikaraṇaṃ dhammikaṃ bhavissati, gaṇhissāma. sace adhammikaṃ, vissajjessāmā'ti, te paṭinissaggamantino nāma honti. ime pana na tathā mantentī'ti appaṭinissaggamantino.

examples.text: ukkhitto nāma āpattiyā adassane vā appaṭikamme vā appaṭinissagge vā ukkhitto.

te taṃ adhikaraṇaṃ ādiyitvā na c'eva aññam'aññaṃ saññāpenti na ca saññattiṃ upagacchanti, na ca nijjhāpenti na ca nijjhattiṃ upagacchanti. te asaññattibalā anijjhattibalā appaṭinissaggamantino tam'eva adhikaraṇaṃ thāmasā parāmāsā abhinivissa voharanti, idam'eva saccaṃ mogham'aññan'ti.

6822.meaning1: not giving up one's idea; not abandoning one's opinion (if it's wrong)
6822.commentary: (ANa) appaṭinissaggamantino'ti yesaṃ hi evaṃ hoti, sace amhehi gahitaṃ adhikaraṇaṃ dhammikaṃ bhavissati, gaṇhissāma. sace adhammikaṃ, vissajjessāmā'ti, te paṭinissaggamantino nāma honti. ime pana na tathā mantentī'ti appaṭinissaggamantino.

examples.text: te taṃ adhikaraṇaṃ ādiyitvā na c'eva aññam'aññaṃ saññāpenti na ca saññattiṃ upagacchanti, na ca nijjhāpenti na ca nijjhattiṃ upagacchanti. te asaññattibalā anijjhattibalā appaṭinissaggamantino tam'eva adhikaraṇaṃ thāmasā parāmāsā abhinivissa voharanti, idam'eva saccaṃ mogham'aññan'ti.

6823.grammar: ger of na paṭinissajjati, neg, trans (+acc)
6823.construction:
na > a + pati + nī + √sajj + ya
na + paṭinissajja

examples.text: atha kho aññataro bhikkhu acirapakkante āyasmante sāriputte bhagavantaṃ etadavoca, āyasmā maṃ, bhante, sāriputto āsajja appaṭinissajja cārikaṃ pakkanto'ti.

6824.meaning2: not giving up; not letting go (of)

6825.meaning2: having the essential function of not letting go (of)

6826.grammar: abs of na paṭinissajjati, neg, trans (+acc)
6826.meaning1: having not given up; having not relinquished; having not renounced; having not abandoned
6826.construction:
na > a + pati + nī + √sajj + itvā
na + paṭinissajjitvā

examples.text: taṃ vācaṃ appahāya, taṃ cittaṃ appahāya taṃ diṭṭhiṃ appaṭinissajjitvā yath'ābhataṃ nikkhitto evaṃ niraye.

6827.meaning1: not given up; not forsaken; not renounced; not abandoned

examples.text: yo pana bhikkhu jānaṃ tathāvādinā bhikkhunā akaṭ'ānudhammena taṃ diṭṭhiṃ appaṭinissaṭṭhena saddhiṃ sambhuñjeyya vā saṃvaseyya vā saha vā seyyaṃ kappeyya, pācittiyaṃ.
taṃ diṭṭhiṃ appaṭinissaṭṭhena saddhin'ti etaṃ diṭṭhiṃ appaṭinissaṭṭhena saddhiṃ.

6828.meaning1: who is not an equal; who is not a peer
6828.commentary: (MNa) appaṭipuggalo'ti ettha ayutto paṭipuggalo appaṭipuggalo. imehi āpatt'ādīhi asadisattā paṭisattu paṭisallo codako bhavituṃ ayutto'ti vuttaṃ hoti.

examples.text: ṭhānaṃ kho pan'etaṃ, āvuso, vijjati yaṃ idh'ekaccassa bhikkhuno evaṃ icchā uppajjeyya, āpattiñ'ca vata āpanno assaṃ, sappaṭipuggalo maṃ codeyya, no appaṭipuggalo'ti.

6829.synonym: anāpara, anupama, asadisa, asama, asamasama, nūpama

examples.text: santassa bhūripaññassa, mahāpaññassa vītalobhassa, tathāgatassa sugatassa, appaṭipuggalassa asamassa, visāradassa nipuṇassa, bhagavato tassa sāvako'ham'asmi.
atthi sakyakule jāto, buddho appaṭipuggalo, sabb'ābhibhū māranudo, sabbattha'm'aparājito.

6830.meaning1: not calm; not internally settled; not at ease; not relaxed

examples.text: āraddhaṃ kho pana me, aggivessana, vīriyaṃ hoti asallīnaṃ, upaṭṭhitā sati asammuṭṭhā, sāraddho ca pana me kāyo hoti appaṭippassaddho ten'eva dukkhappadhānena padhān'ābhitunnassa sato.
diṭṭhe kho ahaṃ, āvuso, anupāyo anapāyo anissito appaṭibaddho vippamutto visaṃyutto vimariyādīkatena cetasā viharāmi.
chandajāto anakkhāte, manasā ca phuṭo siyā, kāmesu ca appaṭibaddhacitto, uddhaṃsoto'ti vuccati.

6832.meaning1: not fearful; not frightful; not risky; not dangerous

examples.text: seyyathā'pi, bhikkhave, puriso addhānamaggappaṭipanno. so passeyya mahantaṃ udak'aṇṇavaṃ, orimaṃ tīraṃ sāsaṅkaṃ sappaṭibhayaṃ, pārimaṃ tīraṃ khemaṃ appaṭibhayaṃ.
sappaṭibhayaṃ nāma tasmiṃ magge corehi manussā hatā dissanti, viluttā dissanti, ākoṭitā dissanti, sappaṭibhayaṃ gantvā appaṭibhayaṃ dassetvā uyyojetabbā, gacchatha bhaginiyo'ti.

6833.meaning1: with no counterpart; with no one resembling
6833.commentary: (ANa) appaṭibhāgo'ti ye tathāgatena cattāro satipaṭṭhānā'ti-ādinā nayena dhammā desitā, tesu na cattāro satipaṭṭhānā, tayo vā pañca vā'ti-ādinā nayena paṭibhāgaṃ kātuṃ samattho nāma n'atthī'ti appaṭibhāgo.

examples.text: ekapuggalo, bhikkhave, loke uppajjamāno uppajjati adutiyo asahāyo appaṭimo appaṭisamo appaṭibhāgo appaṭipuggalo asamo asamasamo dvipadānaṃ aggo. katamo ekapuggalo?

6835.meaning1: unresponsive; dumbfounded; speechless; mute; at a loss for words

examples.text: evaṃ vutte, uttaro māṇavo pārāsiviy'antevāsī tuṇhībhūto maṅkubhūto pattakkhandho adhomukho pajjhāyanto appaṭibhāno nisīdi.

6836.construction:
na > a + pati + √mā + ā + a
appaṭimā + a

examples.text: gantvāna buddho nadikaṃ kakudhaṃ, acch'odakaṃ sāt'udakaṃ vippasannaṃ, ogāhi satthā akilantarūpo, tathāgato appaṭimo ca loke.
ādāya dantāni gaj'uttamassa, vaggū subhe appaṭime pathabyā, suvaṇṇarājīhi samantamodare, so luddako kāsipuraṃ upāgami, upanesi so rājakaññāya dante, nāgo hato handa imassa dantā.

6837.construction: na > a + pati + √mas + ya > massa > maṃsa
6837.commentary: (VINa) acchiddena appaṭimaṃsenā'ti-ādīsu yena gahaṭṭhapabbajitesu yo koci pahaṭo vā hoti, gihīnaṃ gaṇḍaphālan'ādīni vejjakammāni vā katāni, tassa kāyasamācāro upacikāhi khāyitatālapaṇṇam'iva chiddo ca paṭimāsituṃ yattha katthaci gahetvā ākaḍḍhituṃ sakkuṇeyyatāya sappaṭimaṃso ca hoti, viparīto acchiddo appaṭimaṃso'ti veditabbo'ti.

examples.text: codakena, bhikkhave, bhikkhunā paraṃ codetu'kāmena evaṃ paccavekkhitabbaṃ, parisuddhakāyasamācāro nu kho'mhi, parisuddhen'amhi kāyasamācārena samannāgato acchiddena appaṭimaṃsena

6838.synonym: akappiya, akalla, ananucchavika, anānuloma, abhadraka, asāruppa

examples.text: aṭṭh'ime, bhikkhave, hetū aṭṭha paccayā ādibrahmacariyikāya paññāya appaṭiladdhāya paṭilābhāya, paṭiladdhāya bhiyyobhāvāya vepullāya bhāvanāya pāripūriyā saṃvattanti. katame aṭṭha?

6840.meaning2: who has not attained a stage of meditation

6841.meaning1: not obtained before; not previously gotten

examples.text: manoviññeyyānaṃ dhammānaṃ iṭṭhānaṃ kantānaṃ manāpānaṃ manoramānaṃ lok'āmisapaṭisaṃyuttānaṃ appaṭilābhaṃ vā appaṭilābhato samanupassato pubbe vā appaṭiladdhapubbaṃ atītaṃ niruddhaṃ vipariṇataṃ samanussarato uppajjati domanassaṃ.

6842.grammar: prp of na paṭilabhati, neg, trans (+acc)
6842.meaning1: not obtaining; not getting; not personally experiencing

examples.text: tassa mayhaṃ, bhante, taṃ samādhiṃ appaṭilabhato evaṃ hoti, no c'ass'āhaṃ parihāyāmī'ti. ye te, assaji, samaṇabrāhmaṇā samādhisārakā samādhisāmaññā tesaṃ taṃ samādhiṃ appaṭilabhataṃ evaṃ hoti, no c'assu mayaṃ parihāyāmā'ti.

6843.meaning1: not acquiring; not obtaining; not getting

examples.text: manoviññeyyānaṃ dhammānaṃ iṭṭhānaṃ kantānaṃ manāpānaṃ manoramānaṃ lok'āmisapaṭisaṃyuttānaṃ appaṭilābhaṃ vā appaṭilābhato samanupassato pubbe vā appaṭiladdhapubbaṃ atītaṃ niruddhaṃ vipariṇataṃ samanussarato uppajjati domanassaṃ.

6844.grammar: ger of na paṭisaṅkhāti, neg, intrans (+adv)
6844.meaning1: without reflecting; without carefully considering; without due consideration
6844.construction:
na > a + pati + saṃ + √khā + (ya) > khā
na + paṭisaṅkhā

examples.text: addh'āyasmantehi nigaṇṭhehi sahasā appaṭisaṅkhā vācā bhāsitā, na kho, āvuso gotama, sukhena sukhaṃ adhigantabbaṃ, dukkhena kho sukhaṃ adhigantabbaṃ.
so taṃ āpānīyakaṃsaṃ sahasā appaṭisaṅkhā piveyya, nappaṭinissajjeyya. so tatonidānaṃ maraṇaṃ vā nigaccheyya maraṇamattaṃ vā dukkhaṃ.

6845.grammar: ger of na paṭisaṅkhāti, neg, intrans (+adv)
6845.meaning1: without reflecting; without carefully considering; without due consideration
6845.construction:
na > a + pati + saṃ + √khā + ya
na + paṭisaṅkhāya

examples.text: so taṃ appaṭisaṅkhāya piveyya, nappaṭinissajjeyya. tassa taṃ pivato c'eva nacchādeyya vaṇṇena'pi gandhena'pi rasena'pi, pivitvā ca pana maraṇaṃ vā nigaccheyya maraṇamattaṃ vā dukkhaṃ.

6846.construction:
na > a + pati + saṃ + √dhā + i + ka
na + paṭisandhi + ka

examples.text: seyyathā'pi, sunakkhatta, puthusilā dvedhābhinnā appaṭisandhikā hoti. evam'eva kho, sunakkhatta, ākiñcaññ'āyatan'ādhimuttassa purisapuggalassa ye āneñjasaṃyojane se bhinne.
pārājiko hotī'ti seyyathā'pi nāma puthusilā dvidhā bhinnā appaṭisandhikā hoti, evam'eva bhikkhu sañcicca manussaviggahaṃ jīvitā voropetvā assamaṇo hoti asakyaputtiyo.

6847.meaning1: with no linking to another life; incapable of rebirth
6847.construction:
na > a + pati + saṃ + √dhā + i + ka
na + paṭisandhi + ka
6847.commentary: (NIDD1a) gatā appaṭisandhikā'ti niruddhakkhandhānaṃ puna āgantvā paṭisandhānābhāvena gatā appaṭisandhikā'ti vuccanti.

examples.text: ye niruddhā marantassa, tiṭṭhamānassa vā idha, sabbe'pi sadisā khandhā, gatā appaṭisandhikā.

6849.grammar: adj, comp, from na sama, neg
6849.meaning1: without an equal; without a counterpart; peerless
6849.meaning2: without an equal; without a counterpart; incomparable
6849.commentary: (ANa) appaṭisamo'ti attabhāven'ev'assa paṭisamo nāma koci n'atthī'ti appaṭisamo.

examples.text: ekapuggalo, bhikkhave, loke uppajjamāno uppajjati adutiyo asahāyo appaṭimo appaṭisamo appaṭibhāgo appaṭipuggalo asamo asamasamo dvipadānaṃ aggo. katamo ekapuggalo?

6850.meaning1: without a refuge; without support; without resort

examples.text: ye'pi nigaṇṭhassa nāṭaputtassa sāvakā gihī odātavasanā te'pi nigaṇṭhesu nāṭaputtiyesu nibbindarūpā virattarūpā paṭivānarūpā yathā taṃ durakkhāte dhammavinaye duppavedite aniyyānike anupasamasaṃvattanike asammāsambuddhappavedite bhinnathūpe appaṭisaraṇe.

6851.meaning1: unannounced; not alerted; not made known

examples.text: yo pana bhikkhu rañño khattiyassa muddh'ābhisittassa anikkhantarājake aniggataratanake pubbe appaṭisaṃvidito indakhīlaṃ atikkāmeyya, pācittiyaṃ.
atha kho brahm'āyuno brāhmaṇassa avidūre ambavanassa etadahosi, na kho m'etaṃ patirūpaṃ yo'haṃ pubbe appaṭisaṃvidito samaṇaṃ gotamaṃ dassanāya upasaṅkameyyan'ti.
appaṭisaṃvidite appaṭisaṃviditasaññī indakhīlaṃ atikkāmeti, āpatti pācittiyassa. appaṭisaṃvidite vematiko indakhīlaṃ atikkāmeti, āpatti pācittiyassa.

6853.meaningLit: having not caused to know back

6854.grammar: adj, from na paṭisaṃvedanā, neg, caus
6854.constructionSummary: na + pati + saṃ + vede + anā + a
6854.construction:
na > a + pati + saṃ + vede + anā + a
appaṭisaṃvedanā + a
6854.commentary: (DNa) appaṭisaṃvedano me attā'ti iminā rūpakkhandhavatthukā. (DNt) iṭṭh'ādi-bhedaṃ ārammaṇaṃ na paṭisaṃvedetī'ti appaṭisaṃvedano'ti vedakabhāvapaṭikkhepamukhena sañjānan'ādi-bhāvo'pi paṭikkhitto hoti

examples.text: na h'eva kho me vedanā attā, appaṭisaṃvedano me attā'ti iti vā hi, ānanda, attānaṃ samanupassamāno samanupassati.
sant'āvuso, sattā asaññino appaṭisaṃvedino, seyyathā'pi devā asaññasattā. ayaṃ pañcamo satt'āvāso.

6856.grammar: prp of na paṭisevati, neg, trans (+acc)

examples.text: yañ'hi'ssa, bhikkhave, appaṭisevato uppajjeyyuṃ āsavā vighātapariḷāhā, paṭisevato evaṃ'sa te āsavā vighātapariḷāhā na honti. ime vuccanti, bhikkhave, āsavā paṭisevanā pahātabbā

6858.commentary: (ANa) taṃ hoti cakkaṃ appaṭivattiyan'ti taṃ tena evaṃ pavattitaṃ āṇācakkaṃ appaṭivattiyaṃ hoti.

examples.text: iti kho, bhikkhave, vīsati kusalapakkhā, vīsati akusalapakkhā, mahācattārīsako dhammapariyāyo pavattito appaṭivattiyo samaṇena vā brāhmaṇena vā devena vā mārena vā brahmunā vā kenaci vā lokasmiṃ.
etaṃ bhagavatā bārāṇasiyaṃ isipatane migadāye anuttaraṃ dhammacakkaṃ pavattitaṃ appaṭivattiyaṃ samaṇena vā brāhmaṇena vā devena vā mārena vā brahmunā vā kenaci vā lokasmin'ti.

6859.meaning2: not giving up, not turning away (from); non-weariness
6859.construction:
na > a + pati + √vā + ṇa + ī
appaṭivāṇa + ī

examples.text: tasmā dade appaṭivānacitto, yattha dinnaṃ mahapphalaṃ, puññāni paralokasmiṃ, patiṭṭhā honti pāṇinan'ti.
tasmā dade appaṭivānacitto, yattha dinnaṃ mahapphalaṃ. puññāni paralokasmiṃ, patiṭṭhā honti pāṇinan'ti.

6862.grammar: fem, abstr, from na appaṭivānī, neg (+loc)
6862.meaning1: tirelessness (in); determination (in); unflagging resolution (towards); indefatigability (towards); relentlessness (towards)
6862.construction:
na > a + pati + √vā + na + ī + tā
na + paṭivānī + tā

examples.text: dvinn'āhaṃ, bhikkhave, dhammānaṃ upaññāsiṃ, yā ca asantuṭṭhitā kusalesu dhammesu, yā ca appaṭivānitā padhānasmiṃ.

6863.meaning1: indefatigability; zeal; tireless determination; resolute intention
6863.construction:
na > a + pati + √vā + na + ī
appaṭivāna + ī

examples.text: tena, bhikkhave, bhikkhunā tesaṃ'y'eva pāpakānaṃ akusalānaṃ dhammānaṃ pahānāya adhimatto chando ca vāyāmo ca ussāho ca ussoḷhī ca appaṭivānī ca sati ca sampajaññañ'ca karaṇīyaṃ.

iti evarūpiṃ sīlapārisuddhiṃ aparipūraṃ vā paripūressāmi paripūraṃ vā tattha tattha paññāya anuggahessāmī'ti, yo tattha chando ca vāyāmo ca ussāho ca ussoḷhī ca appaṭivānī ca sati ca sampajaññañ'ca, idaṃ vuccati, byagghapajjā, sīlapārisuddhi-padhāniy'aṅgaṃ.

6864.meaning2: not to be given up; not causing weariness or satiety
6864.commentary: (SNa) tañ'ca pana appaṭivānīyan'ti tañ'ca pana dhammaṃ appaṭivānīyaṃ deseti. bāhirakañ'hi sumadhuram'pi bhojanaṃ punappunaṃ bhuñjantassa na ruccati, apanetha, kiṃ iminā'ti? paṭivānetabbaṃ apanetabbaṃ hoti, na evam'ayaṃ dhammo. imaṃ hi dhammaṃ paṇḍitā vassasatam'pi vassasahassam'pi suṇantā tittiṃ na gacchanti. ten'āha appaṭivānīyan'ti. (THIa) tañ'ca appaṭivānīyan'ti tañ'ca pana dhammaṃ anivattitabhāv'āvahaṃ niyyānikaṃ, abhikkantatāya vā yathā sotujana-savana-manohara-bhāvena anapanīyaṃ

examples.text: tañ'ca pana appaṭivānīyaṃ, asecanakam'ojavaṃ, pivanti maññe sappaññā, valāhakam'iva panthagū'ti.

6865.grammar: prp of na paṭivijjhati, neg, trans (+acc)

examples.text: tuvaṭaṃ cittaṃ samādhiyati, mukhavaṇṇo vippasīdati, asammūḷho kālaṃ karoti, uttari appaṭivijjhanto brahmalok'ūpago hoti.
taṃ vā pana anabhisambhavaṃ appaṭivijjhaṃ pañcannaṃ oram'bhāgiyānaṃ saṃyojanānaṃ parikkhayā antarāparinibbāyī hoti.

6866.meaning1: not understood; not perceived; not comprehended; not personally known

examples.text: yesaṃ dhammā appaṭividitā, paravādesu nīyare, suttā te nappabujjhanti, kālo tesaṃ pabujjhitun'ti.

samayo'pi kho te, bhaddāli, appaṭividdho ahosi, bhagavā kho sāvatthiyaṃ viharati, bhagavā'pi maṃ jānissati, bhaddāli nāma bhikkhu satthusāsane sikkhāya aparipūrakārī'ti. ayam'pi kho te, bhaddāli, samayo appaṭividdho ahosi.

6869.grammar: pp of na paṭivineti, in comps, neg

examples.text: tassa sā sakkāyadiṭṭhi thāmagatā appaṭivinītā oram'bhāgiyaṃ saṃyojanaṃ.

6870.grammar: abs of na paṭivinodeti, neg, caus, trans (+acc)
6870.meaning1: having not driven out; having not dispelled; having not removed; having not got rid (of)
6870.construction:
na > a + pati + vi + node + tvā
na + paṭivinodetvā

examples.text: api nu te diṭṭho vā suto vā rājā vā rājamah'āmatto vā pañcahi kāmaguṇehi samappito samaṅgībhūto paricārayamāno kāmataṇhaṃ appahāya kāmapariḷāhaṃ appaṭivinodetvā vigatapipāso ajjhattaṃ vūpasantacitto vihāsi vā viharati vā viharissati vā'ti?

6871.commentary: (ANa) appaṭivibhattā'ti ettakaṃ dassāmi ettakaṃ na dassāmi, idaṃ dassāmi idaṃ na dassāmī'ti cittaṃ uppādentena hi paṭivibhattā nāma hoti, mayhaṃ pana na evaṃ. atha kho saṅghikā viya gaṇasantakā viya ca sīlavantehi saddhiṃ sādhāraṇāyeva.

examples.text: saṃvijjanti kho pana me, bhante, kule bhogā. te ca kho appaṭivibhattā sīlavantehi kalyāṇadhammehi. ayaṃ kho me, bhante, catuttho acchariyo abbhuto dhammo saṃvijjati.

puna caparaṃ, bhikkhave, bhikkhu ye te lābhā dhammikā dhammaladdhā antamaso pattapariyāpannamattam'pi tathārūpehi lābhehi appaṭivibhattabhogī hoti sīlavantehi sabrahmacārīhi sādhāraṇabhogī, ayam'pi dhammo sāraṇīyo.

6872.meaning1: who does not eat without sharing; who shares without reservation
6872.commentary: (ANa) appaṭivibhattabhogī'ti ettha dve paṭivibhattāni nāma āmisapaṭivibhattaṃ pana puggalapaṭivibhattañ'ca. tattha, ettakaṃ dassāmi, ettakaṃ na dassāmī'ti evaṃ cittena paṭivibhajanaṃ āmisapaṭivibhattaṃ nāma. asukassa dassāmi, asukassa na dassāmī'ti evaṃ cittena vibhajanaṃ pana puggalapaṭivibhattaṃ nāma. tadubhayam'pi akatvā yo appaṭivibhattaṃ bhuñjati, ayaṃ appaṭivibhattabhogī nāma.

examples.text: puna caparaṃ, bhikkhave, bhikkhu ye te lābhā dhammikā dhammaladdhā antamaso pattapariyāpannamattam'pi tathārūpehi lābhehi appaṭivibhattabhogī hoti sīlavantehi sabrahmacārīhi sādhāraṇabhogī, ayam'pi dhammo sāraṇīyo.

6873.grammar: pp of na na paṭiviramati, neg (+abl)
6873.meaning1: not abstained; not desisted (from); not given up
6873.commentary: (ANa) surāmerayapānā appaṭiviratā'ti pañcavidhāya surāya catubbidhassa merayassa ca pānato aviratā.

examples.text: yebhuyyena kho pana, bhante, yakkhā appaṭiviratāy'eva pāṇ'ātipātā, appaṭiviratā adinn'ādānā, appaṭiviratā kāmesumicchācārā, appaṭiviratā musāvādā, appaṭiviratā surā-meraya-majja-ppamādaṭṭhānā. tesaṃ taṃ hoti appiyaṃ amanāpaṃ.
katame cattāro? santi, bhikkhave, eke samaṇabrāhmaṇā suraṃ pivanti merayaṃ, surāmerayapānā appaṭiviratā.

6874.meaning1: not opposed; not against; not averse

examples.text: sammā byākaramānā, bhikkhave, aññatitthiyā paribbājakā evaṃ byākareyyuṃ, ananuruddha-appaṭiviruddhass'āvuso, sā niṭṭhā, na sā niṭṭhā anuruddhappaṭiviruddhassā'ti.

6875.meaning2: not reviewed; not reflected; not inspected

6876.grammar: abs of na paccavekkhati, neg, trans (+acc)
6876.meaning1: having not checked; having not inspected
6876.construction:
na > a + pati + ava + √ikkh + itvā
na + paṭivekkhitvā

examples.text: catunnaṃ, bhikkhave, dhammānaṃ ananubodhā appaṭivedhā evam'idaṃ dīgham'addhānaṃ sandhāvitaṃ saṃsaritaṃ mamañ'c'eva tumhākañ'ca
avijjā'ti… adassanaṃ anabhisamayo ananubodho asambodho appaṭivedho asaṃgāhanā apariyogāhanā asamapekkhanā apaccavekkhaṇā

6878.grammar: prp of na paṭihaññati, neg, pass, intrans
6878.meaning1: not being struck; not being hit; not being beaten

6879.commentary: (NIDD1a) appaṭihatan'ti nirāvaraṇataṃ dasseti. puna sabbaññutaṃ upamāya sādhetu'kāmo

examples.text: indriyaparopariyatta-ñāṇaṃ tathāgatassa tathāgatabalaṃ, sattānaṃ āsay'ānusaya-ñāṇaṃ tathāgatassa tathāgatabalaṃ, yamakapāṭihīre ñāṇaṃ tathāgatassa tathāgatabalaṃ, mahākaruṇāsamāpattiyā ñāṇaṃ tathāgatassa tathāgatabalaṃ, sabbaññutañāṇaṃ tathāgatassa tathāgatabalaṃ, anāvaraṇañāṇaṃ tathāgatassa tathāgatabalaṃ, sabbattha asaṅgam'appaṭihatam'anāvaraṇañāṇaṃ tathāgatassa tathāgatabalaṃ.

6881.meaning1: without an escort; without a bodyguard; unimpeded
6881.construction:
na > a + pati + √har > hār + *a + ika
appaṭihāra + ika

examples.text: santapaṇītadhammapaccavekkhaṇavasena uppannattā. yathā hi rājavallabho cūḷ'upaṭṭhāko appaṭihārikaṃ yathāsukhaṃ rājakulaṃ pavisanto seṭṭhisenāpati-ādayo pādena paharanto'pi na gaṇeti.

6882.meaning1: having few involvements; with few duties; having few activities

examples.text: idha, bhikkhave, bhikkhu app'aṭṭho hoti appakicco subharo susantoso jīvitaparikkhāresu, app'āhāro hoti anodarikattaṃ anuyutto, appamiddho hoti jāgariyaṃ anuyutto

brāhmaṇā, bho gotama, evam'āhaṃsu, mah'aṭṭham'idaṃ mahākiccaṃ mah'ādhikaraṇaṃ mahāsamārambhaṃ ghar'āvāsakammaṭṭhānaṃ mahapphalaṃ hoti, app'aṭṭham'idaṃ appakiccaṃ app'ādhikaraṇaṃ appasamārambhaṃ pabbajjā kammaṭṭhānaṃ appaphalaṃ hotī'ti. idha bhavaṃ gotamo kim'āhā'ti.

6883.commentary: (ANa) app'aṭṭhatarā'ti yattha bahūhi veyyāvaccakarehi vā upakaraṇehi vā attho n'atthi. (DNt) app'aṭṭhataro'ti pana ativiya appakicco'ti attho.

examples.text: atthi pana, bho gotama, añño yañño imāya tividhāya yaññasampadāya soḷasaparikkhārāya app'aṭṭhataro ca appasamārambhataro ca mahapphalataro ca mah'ānisaṃsataro cā'ti?

6884.meaning1: fact of having few involvements; state of having few duties; fact of having few undertakings

6885.meaning2: fixing of thought on an object, attainment of a trance

6886.grammar: nt, act, from na paṇidahati, neg
6886.meaning1: not making an aspiration; not making a wish; not setting an intention

examples.text: iti me cakkhu siyā anāgatam'addhānaṃ iti rūpā'ti, appaṭiladdhassa paṭilābhāya cittaṃ nappaṇidahati, cetaso appaṇidhānapaccayā na tadabhinandati, na tadabhinandanto anāgataṃ nappaṭikaṅkhati.

6887.meaning1: due to not making an aspiration; based on not wishing (for the future)

examples.text: iti me cakkhu siyā anāgatam'addhānaṃ iti rūpā'ti, appaṭiladdhassa paṭilābhāya cittaṃ nappaṇidahati, cetaso appaṇidhānapaccayā na tadabhinandati, na tadabhinandanto anāgataṃ nappaṭikaṅkhati.

6888.grammar: ger of na paṇidahati, neg, trans (+acc)
6888.meaning1: not guiding; not applying; not directing
6888.construction:
na > a + pa + ni + √dhā + ya
na + paṇidhāya

examples.text: kathañ'c'ānanda appaṇidhāya bhāvanā hoti?

6889.commentary: (SNa) bahiddhā'ti mūlakammaṭṭhānaṃ pahāya bahi aññasmiṃ ārammaṇe. appaṇidhāyā'ti aṭṭhapetvā. atha pacchā pure asaṃkhittaṃ vimuttaṃ appaṇihitan'ti pajānātī'ti ettha kammaṭṭhānavasena vā sarīravasena vā desanāvasena vā attho veditabbo.

examples.text: appaṇihitaṃ me bahiddhā cittan'ti pajānāti

6890.meaning2: desireless, not looking to something superior
6890.commentary: (PM) katamo appaṇihito vimokkho? idha bhikkhu araññagato vā rukkhamūlagato vā suññ'āgāragato vā iti paṭisañcikkhati, suññam'idaṃ attena vā attaniyena vā'ti. so tattha paṇidhiṃ na karotī'ti, appaṇihito vimokkho. ayaṃ appaṇihito vimokkho. (VINa) rāgadosamohapaṇidhīnaṃ abhāvato appaṇihito'ti vuccati. (MNa) yo dukkhato pariggahetvā dukkhato disvā dukkhato vuṭṭhāti, tassa appaṇihitā nāma.

examples.text: saññāvedayitanirodha-samāpattiyā vuṭṭhitaṃ pan'āyye, bhikkhuṃ kati phassā phusantīti? saññāvedayitanirodha-samāpattiyā vuṭṭhitaṃ kho, āvuso visākha, bhikkhuṃ tayo phassā phusanti, suññato phasso, animitto phasso, appaṇihito phasso'ti.

ko nu kho, bhante, hetu, ko paccayo yena pubbe appatarāni c'eva sikkhāpadāni ahesuṃ bahutarā ca bhikkhū aññāya saṇṭhahiṃsu? ko pana, bhante, hetu, ko paccayo yena eta'r'ahi bahutarāni c'eva sikkhāpadāni honti appatarā ca bhikkhū aññāya saṇṭhahantī'ti?

6893.meaning2: (comm) not worthy of consideration or respect

6895.meaning1: unestablished; without basis; without support; (comm) without support from below and not hanging from above
6895.construction:
na > a + pati + √ṭhā + ā + a
appatiṭṭhā + a

examples.text: kathaṃsu tarati oghaṃ, rattin'divam'atandito, appatiṭṭhe anālambe, ko gambhīre na sīdatī'ti.
tatr'āp'āhaṃ, bhikkhave, n'eva āgatiṃ vadāmi, na gatiṃ, na ṭhitiṃ, na cutiṃ, na upapattiṃ. appatiṭṭhaṃ, appavattaṃ, anārammaṇam'ev'etaṃ. es'ev'anto dukkhassā'ti.

6896.grammar: prp of na patiṭṭhahati, neg, intrans
6896.meaning1: without relying; not depending; without leaning

examples.text: kathaṃ nu tvaṃ, mārisa, ogham'atarī'ti? appatiṭṭhaṃ khv'āhaṃ, āvuso, anāyūhaṃ ogham'atarin'ti.

6897.grammar: prp of na patiṭṭhahati, neg, intrans
6897.meaning1: not standing still; not staying in place; not halting; not fixing on

examples.text: kathaṃ nu tvaṃ, mārisa, ogham'atarī'ti? appatiṭṭhaṃ khv'āhaṃ, āvuso, anāyūhaṃ ogham'atarin'ti.
tadappatiṭṭhitaṃ viññāṇaṃ avirūḷhaṃ anabhisaṅkhacca vimuttaṃ. vimuttattā ṭhitaṃ. ṭhitattā santusitaṃ. santusitattā na paritassati. aparitassaṃ paccattaññ'eva parinibbāyati.
viññāṇe ce, bhikkhave, āhāre n'atthi rāgo n'atthi nandī n'atthi taṇhā, appatiṭṭhitaṃ tattha viññāṇaṃ avirūḷhaṃ. yattha appatiṭṭhitaṃ viññāṇaṃ avirūḷhaṃ, n'atthi tattha nāmarūpassa avakkanti.
atha puriso āgaccheyya, ahaṃ imesaṃ catunnaṃ daḷhadhammānaṃ dhanuggahānaṃ susikkhitānaṃ katahatthānaṃ kat'ūpāsanānaṃ catuddisā kaṇḍe khitte appatiṭṭhite pathaviyaṃ gahetvā āharissāmī'ti.
